description.value: Tall Tree Bakery is an artisan bakery in Squamish established in 2016 by husband-and-wife team Sean and Erin, both outdoor enthusiasts and veterans of the Canadian Armed Forces. The bakery produces high-quality breads and pastries baked fresh each morning from clean-label ingredients, and was recognized with the Best Small Business Service Excellence Award by the Squamish Chamber of Commerce in 2018. Touring cyclists will find a wide selection of freshly baked artisan breads, pastries, baguette sandwiches, grilled paninis, and locally-roasted coffee.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website provides comprehensive content confirming this is an active artisan bakery in Squamish with phone, address, and URL all matching OSM. The menu explicitly lists grilled paninis and a full hot coffee menu, supporting hot food; no mention of bike parking, water refill, or cycling infrastructure appears anywhere on the site, so those remain null. OSM's opening hours (Tu-Fr 08:00-17:00; Sa-Su 09:00-16:00) directly contradict the website (Wed-Sun 8:00am-3:00pm, closed Mon-Tue), so the website value is treated as authoritative and the discrepancy is flagged.
